Equipment to be delivered to purchaser's manufacturing site by May 2012.
Confidentiality agreement with Teyma USA & Abener Engineering and Construction Services General Partnership.
The document specifies the engineering requirements for a Guided Wave Radar Level Instrument.
It includes details on process conditions, sensor specifications, transmitter parameters, and accessories.
The instrument is designed to measure the level of Heat Transfer Fluid in an overflow tank.
The calibration range is provided in Sketch 1.
ABB is the manufacturer of the transmitter.
The instrument operates within a temperature range of 20°F to 125°F.
The document specifies two guided wave radar level instruments for an HTF system.
Both instruments are designed for measuring the level of a heat transfer fluid in a still well.
They operate under conditions ranging from 500°F to 750°F and pressures up to 350 psig.
The sensors use non-insulated cables with specific lengths and materials.
Transmitters are HART type, providing 4-20mA output signals.
Both instruments require calibration and come with accessories like mounting kits and sun shields.
The document describes the specifications for a Magnetic Float / Guided Wave Level Instrument.
It includes details on process conditions, float and gauge specifications, transmitter parameters, and accessories.
The instrument is designed for use in a Still Well with an operating temperature range of 500-750°F.
The transmitter outputs 4..20mA DC Loop Powered - HART and has a power supply of 24VDC.
Accessories include a mounting kit, sun shield, and heat trace/insulation.
The document is part of the Solana Power Plant project and is subject to revisions.
